value.rationale: Identifies a motivated exact finite-complexity boundary in mean-preserving delay models: beyond low-order Gamma damping, at the minimal kernel stage 28, phase-index ordering ceases to predict time order. The new two-mode unstable interval and codimension-two distinct-frequency crossing have direct import for delay-induced stability windows; the exact parameter inequality and certified minimum are not arbitrary slices or simple textbook rescalings.
